script_text: Libra, the cosmos shatters your calm this July as a rare portal opens, and as an Air sign your mental equilibrium is tested like never before. Jupiter enters Leo on July 7, transiting your 11th house of networks. This expansion urges you to embrace unconventional allies. Your ruler Venus joins Leo in your 11th house, igniting friendship-based romance. Venus trine Saturn in your 7th house mid-month stabilizes committed bonds. Saturn in Aries in your 7th house forces clear business boundaries and contracts. Jupiter's 11th-house boost opens collaborative income streams. Mars in Virgo in your 6th house sharpens routines, granting steady vitality. Watch July 14's New Moon in Cancer in your 10th house of career, and July 22 Sun opposite Pluto in Aquarius stirring partnership power shifts. Avoid impulsive signatures near July 30's Mercury shadow. Comment your sign and claim your reading now.
